objective:
B1: Strictly validate base as an object and operations as list of at most50 items. A document/value is nested objects and scalar null/bool/int/string only: no arrays/floats, int strictly -1000000..1000000, strings at most80Unicode codepoints. Every object key matches ASCII [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,31}. Count every object and scalar value as a node (keys not nodes): at most200nodes; root depth0, child depth+1, maxdepth6. An operation is exactly {op,path,value} for set/test or {op,path} for remove. op is one of those3strings; path is1..6valid key strings. Validate the complete original base and ALL operation shapes/values before executing any operations. Shape/range violations raise ValueError (HTTP422), even if an earlier well-shaped operation would conflict.

B2: Expose config_preview.domain.preview(base,operations). Work on a deep copy; never mutate/alias input objects on success or failure. Apply operations sequentially. All parent path components must already exist and be objects. set writes/replaces the final key with a deep copy of value; remove requires final key present and deletes it. After each operation the resulting whole document must still meet node/depth/type bounds. Return exactly {document:result,audit:[{index,op,path,before:{present,value},after:{present,value}}]}; zero-based index, original operation order, copied path; absent value is null with present:false (distinct from present null). Empty operations returns a copied base and empty audit. Expose config_preview.audit.event(index,op,path,before_present,before_value,after_present,after_value) for valid operation metadata; it returns that one audit event with copied path/deep-copied values, forcing null for absent values; domain.preview uses it.

B3: test requires final key present and structurally equal to value, comparing scalar types exactly: true is not1 and false is not0; object key order irrelevant. It leaves document unchanged but adds ordinary before/after audit. Conflict is config_preview.errors.Conflict(ValueError) with integer index and code. Codes: parent_missing for an absent intermediate key; parent_not_object for a scalar intermediate; missing for remove of absent final key; test_failed for absent/unequal test target; limit when applying an otherwise valid operation exceeds whole-document capacity. Stop at first conflict and expose no partial result; original inputs remain unchanged.

B4: Add POST /config/preview JSON exactly {base,operations}; wire domain.preview through real HTTP. Success200 returns its result. Invalid shapes/ranges/unknown fields422 (detail text unspecified). Conflict409 returns exactly {error:{index,code}}. Requests stateless. Keep GET /health={status:"ok"}, POST /sum with exactly {values:[strict integers]}→{total:sum} and invalid422, and unknown-route404. App target config_preview.app:app; preserve src-layout installable package and exact declared dependencies/build backend.

B5: Add at least three meaningful unittest test methods discoverable from the project root, covering ordinary behavior, an edge case, and rejection/nonmutation; tests must pass offline. Update README.md with at least40words explaining behavior and errors, a concrete JSON request/response example, and working run/server and unittest commands. Preserve baseline interfaces. No new dependencies. Semantic review will assess test/docs usefulness; a test count alone is not proof. Use the approved python-api profile: CPython3.12.13,FastAPI0.115.12,Uvicorn0.34.2,Pydantic2.13.5,HTTPX0.28.1 for tests,setuptools78.1.0. Build/install offline. Tests run after wheel installation using python -m unittest discover -s /path/to/project from arbitrary cwd; no source-layout PYTHONPATH workaround. Include HTTP behavior among meaningful tests.

Independent milestone checks cover B1,B2 on non-rename/non-test-operation cases; full acceptance covers ALL requirements. Both child contexts retain all requirements.
